plan.name: Marathon Goal 5h00
plan.description: Progressive 16-week plan, ideal for a first marathon or a 5-hour goal. 3 running sessions per week focused on consistency and endurance.

cycles.name: Phase 1: General Development
cycles.description: Building the aerobic base and developing speed (VO2 Max).

sessions.name: Fun Fartlek
sessions.description: Rhythm changes by feel. 10x 1min fast / 1min slow.

sessions.name: Easy Run
sessions.description: Continuous run at a very comfortable pace to get the body used to running.

sessions.name: Long Run
sessions.description: Key session of the week. Slow, conversational pace.

sessions.name: Long Run
sessions.description: Increasing the duration of the long run.

sessions.name: Pyramid Intervals
sessions.description: Varying paces: 1'-2'-3'-2'-1' (Recovery is half of effort time).

sessions.name: Easy Run with Strides
sessions.description: Easy run + 5 progressive accelerations of 15s at the end.

cycles.name: Phase 2: Specific Development
cycles.description: Introduction of Marathon Pace and lengthening of long runs.

sessions.name: Long Intervals
sessions.description: 3 x 8 min at 'comfortably fast' pace (close to Half-Marathon pace).

sessions.name: Threshold
sessions.description: 2 x 12 min at Threshold pace (slightly faster than marathon pace).

sessions.name: Short Fartlek
sessions.description: 8 x 1min/1min to keep dynamism without fatigue.

sessions.name: Marathon Pace
sessions.description: 20 minutes warmup, then 2 x 15min marathon pace.

sessions.name: Long Run 2h00
sessions.description: Crossing the 2h mark. It's a psychological milestone!

sessions.name: Threshold Reminder
sessions.description: 3 x 8 min slightly faster than marathon pace.

sessions.name: Max Long Run 2h30
sessions.description: The biggest run of the plan (or 2h40 max if feeling good). Test nutrition.

sessions.name: Marathon Pace
sessions.description: 2 x 20 min marathon pace. To memorize the rhythm.

cycles.name: Phase 3: Tapering
cycles.description: Progressive reduction of volume to arrive fresh on race day.

sessions.name: Pace Reminder
sessions.description: 3 x 10 min marathon pace. Keeping intensity but lowering volume.

sessions.name: Dynamic Easy Run
sessions.description: 40 min with 5 min marathon pace in the middle.

sessions.name: Shakeout Run
sessions.description: Day before the race: 20 min very slow + 2 strides.

sessions.name: MARATHON
sessions.description: The big day! Goal 5h00. Start conservatively (7:10/km) and be consistent.
